description_expanded: This wonderful four-story home with multiple sleeping quarters and two separate living areas with kitchens can accommodate 10 fortunate beach-going guests. The design is perfect for creating magical memories during your next beach reunion since individual members of your family and friends can enjoy their own space. It has a fantastic location at the eastern gateway to the idyllic world of Scenic 30A in fashionable Inlet Beach, placing you a very short stroll away from the sugary shoreline. The first-floor level of Seas the Surf  (formerly known as Memories at Inlet Beach) hosts a spacious studio living area with coastal-style furnishings that are vibrantly decorated in gorgeous shades of blue and creams. Comfortable seating includes a royal blue-colored couch and a regal patterned accent armchair. An open Bunk area on one side contains two queen-sized beds, while a white country table on the other side holds four seats for dining. The kitchenette features brushed stainless steel appliances, mottled granite-topped counters, and plenty of cabinetry to fulfill all your culinary needs. A covered outdoor porch includes an outdoor shower, a storage closet for your beach items, and a gas grill to create fun family feasts. A full bath on this level includes a walk-in shower. The main open living, dining, and kitchen areas are on the second floor. This bright space incorporates multiple windows for natural light and vivid views of the glittering gulf. Beach washed hardwood vinyl flooring, a rustic ceiling beam, along with a blend of inviting contemporary and cottage-style furnishings - provide a chic coastal style look. A large sectional beneath a colorful abstract painting, a dark blue armchair, a beautifully patterned accent chair, and a unique round glass-topped hardwood cocktail table ensemble around a decorative rug. An extra-large flatscreen TV on a cream-colored credenza provides entertainment. The dining area includes a rich hardwood topped rectangular table accented by a cream-colored frame and six matching cottage-style ladder-backed chairs beside two walls of windows offering lovely gulf views. A sundeck nearby includes a table with chairs for drinks and dining alfresco while relishing the sparkling views firsthand. The upscale kitchen features brushed stainless steel appliances, light oyster-toned cabinetry, and a gleaming white quartz-topped island bar with three raised tropically inspired straw woven chairs for additional entertaining space. A half-bath powder room is conveniently located on this level with a stacked washer and dryer. The Primary Bedroom Suite spans across the third floor with a king-sized bed framed by two windows, a corner desk/workspace, and an entire sidewall of windows providing gorgeous gulf views. Its ensuite bath includes a quartz-topped vanity and a walk-in shower. The top floor features a lovely family suite with two twin-sized beds, a bunk area with a twin bunk bed, a kitchenette with a coffee station along with a mini-refrigerator, and a balcony providing stellar rooftop views of the gulf. The balcony is furnished with a bar table and chairs, in addition to two chaise lounge chairs for enjoying the summer sun. The ensuite bath includes a walk-in shower and a mottled quartz-topped vanity. This great Inlet Beach location is close to amazing shopping adventures and various great restaurants at the swank 30Avenue Shops . The enchanting nearby coastal village of Rosemary Beach features dining establishments, shopping venues, fun festivals, outdoor concerts, and seasonal firework displays. Nature lovers will love the Camp Helen State Park , which is minutes away on a giant coastal dune. First Floor: Bonus Room with  Queen Bunk and  Screened Porch Access, Kitchenette, Dining, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, Powder Room, Laundry. Third Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower. Fourth Floor: Two Twin Bedroom with Twin Bunk Nook and Walk-In Shower + Balcony Access. Rates reflect a discount for nearby construction.
